skill.name: ecommerce-main-image-copywriter
skill.description: Draft headlines, subtitles, and short selling points for product main images. Use a product brief or look up supported Douyin and Xiaohongshu listings through SocialDataX.
skill.summary: Turn product facts into main-image copy with suggested visuals and a list of claims to verify.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most flags reflect Markdown formatting, product identifiers, or Chinese prose. Online CLI workflows direct users or agents to run an unpinned npm package that can access a SocialDataX credential. Shell examples lack safe argument handling, and billing guidance trusts links from error responses without explicit validation.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI execution during lookup and credential setup
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed, exact CLI version and verify its integrity before execution. Obtain explicit approval before downloading or running it with access to credentials.

remediation.issue: CLI access to environment credentials and persistent credentials
remediation.suggestion: Use a narrowly scoped service token in an isolated execution environment. Prefer an operating system credential store and avoid inheriting unrelated secrets.
Pass validated product identifiers, URLs, and keywords as separate arguments without shell interpolation. Validate product URLs against the supported platform hosts.

remediation.issue: Billing guidance trusts links from error responses
remediation.suggestion: Ignore billing URLs from responses and direct users to the fixed SocialDataX billing page or their account dashboard. Require user confirmation before resuming billable calls.

content.user_title: Write Copy for Ecommerce Main Images
content.value_statement: Product listings often contain more detail than a main image can show. Turn verified product facts into short headline options, supporting copy, and visual directions.
actual_capabilities: Draft copy from a supplied product brief without making an online lookup.
Produce three distinct copy options by default, each with a headline, subtitle, and up to three short selling points.
Suggest a product detail or usage scene to show with each option.
Look up supported Douyin and Xiaohongshu product details through an authenticated SocialDataX connection.
Review a small set of related listings on request for messaging angles and information structure.
Cite the source of product facts and flag missing or conflicting information for review.
limitations: Online lookup supports only Douyin and Xiaohongshu product listings and requires authenticated SocialDataX access.
The documented CLI route runs an unpinned npm package and can access configured credentials.
The skill suggests visuals but does not create, edit, verify, or publish images.
Listing data does not independently verify claims, and the skill does not guarantee better click rates.

use_cases.title: Draft a product launch image
use_cases.description: Turn a confirmed specification sheet into three headline and subtitle options before sending the brief to design.

use_cases.title: Plan the image hierarchy
use_cases.description: Decide which feature to show first and which supporting details belong in secondary image positions.

use_cases.title: Review messaging angles
use_cases.description: Compare a few related listings for presentation ideas while keeping each claim tied to the target product.

prompt_templates.title: Draft one main image
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Write from a short brief.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write one headline, one subtitle, and two short selling points using only these facts: 500 mL bottle, carry loop, and removable lid. Suggest one product photo.

prompt_templates.title: Compare three angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft three angles for commuters using this bag specification sheet: [paste facts]. Keep headlines to five words. Give each option a subtitle, selling points, and a visual suggestion.

prompt_templates.title: Write from a supported listing
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Check listing details before drafting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use an existing authenticated SocialDataX connection to look up this Douyin product: [URL or product ID]. Cite the listing and lookup time. Flag missing facts before recommending copy.

prompt_templates.title: Benchmark a multi-image brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Combine research with layout planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these confirmed product facts: [paste brief]. With an existing authenticated SocialDataX connection, review up to three comparable Xiaohongshu listings for structure only. Assign verified claims and visual suggestions to three image positions. Flag gaps and conflicts.

output_examples.input: Draft a main image for a 500 mL bottle with a removable lid and carry loop.
output: Subtitle: Bring it along with the built-in carry loop.
Suggested visual: Show the carry loop and place the detached lid beside the bottle.
Source: User-provided brief. Leak resistance and insulation were not provided.

output_examples.input: Plan two images for a 16 L backpack with two side pockets and a padded sleeve. The sleeve dimensions are unknown.
output: Main image: 16 L Backpack. Show the full bag and both side pockets.
Secondary image: Padded Interior Sleeve. Show the open bag and the sleeve.
Source: User-provided brief. Confirm sleeve dimensions before claiming a device size.

best_practices: Provide confirmed specifications, the audience, and any headline length or layout limits.
Use one supported benefit per option and show the detail that supports it.
Verify prices, promotions, and other changing facts before publishing.
anti_patterns: Copy a competing listing or reuse its specifications as your own.
Invent certifications, performance figures, discounts, or sales guarantees.
Paste an API key into a prompt, screenshot, or shared document.

faq.question: Can I use the skill without an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the product facts directly and the skill can draft copy without an online lookup.

faq.question: Which links can it look up?
faq.answer: It supports Douyin and Xiaohongshu product links and their platform-specific identifiers. For other platforms, provide the product details directly.

faq.question: What does online lookup require?
faq.answer: Use an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection or a CLI configured with a SocialDataX key. The CLI route requires Node.js and npm.

faq.question: How many copy options does it produce?
faq.answer: It defaults to three options. You can specify the number of options, maximum length, and image positions.

faq.question: Will it generate or publish the image?
faq.answer: No. It provides copy and visual suggestions without generating, editing, or publishing image files.

faq.question: Can it use competing listings as references?
faq.answer: Yes, when requested. It reviews a small set for presentation ideas without copying text or applying competitor claims to your product.
